children: Tech enthusiasts and Wall Street are tuning in ahead of Apple's
big product event today, which will be the first device lineup showcased since John Ternus took the helm.
Before the curtains rise on the products, including Apple's
first foldable phone, it's worth flashing back to see where it all began.
While the tech powerhouse is now a multi-trillion-dollar giant, it debuted on the Nasdaq in December 1980 at a split-adjusted price of $0.10 per share.
Here's what a small stake bought back then and held until today would be worth:

in Dec. 1980, that investment would be worth nearly $2.6M today, according to WhatifInvest's calculator. Going lower, if one invested just $100 in Dec. 1980, that investment would be worth ~$264K at present.
In a recent analysis, Investing Group Leader Envision Research wrote that Apple's
compound annual growth rate is around 9.4% for the six years between FY 2026 and 2031.
"Under this projected rate, AAPL's market capitalization
sometime between FY 2028 and 2029 under its current P/E multiple and also current share count," they estimated. Apple's current market cap is $4.61T.

title: Apple's next chapter: Measuring its stock gains since 1980
